trace.notes: Mapped a 37-page survey paper titled 'Some Open Problems in Low Dimensional Dynamical Systems'. Explicit numbered problems 1-33 appear across Sections 2 through 8: periodic orbits (1-11), period function (12-16), piecewise linear systems (17-18), global asymptotic stability (19-21), geometrical problems (22-25), polynomial problems (26-30), and dynamical conjectures (31-33).
Extracted Problems 1-11 from Section 2, including subparted questions on cubic systems and monomial-count bounds.
Extracted Problems 12-16 from Section 3 on critical periods, centers, and period functions.
Extracted Problems 17-18 from Section 4, both formulated as table-improvement questions for piecewise linear systems.
Extracted Problems 19-21 from Section 5 on continuous, discrete, and random stability questions.
Extracted Problems 22-25 from Section 6 on triangular billiards, Poncelet maps, and Loewner's conjecture.
Extracted Problems 26-33 from Sections 7 and 8 on moments, fewnomials, Casas-Alvero, and three recreational-dynamics conjectures.

Rewrote each numbered problem into a self-contained question by inlining definitions such as HM[m], T(n), the relevant differential or difference equations, and the exact objects whose extremal behavior is being asked about, while keeping one accepted item per numbered problem in the survey.

No duplicates were merged. Several problems are thematically related, but each numbered item asks a distinct mathematical question, so all 33 numbered problems were preserved as separate canonical outputs.

All accepted items passed self-containedness, evidence coverage, evidence completeness, no-new-facts, and schema checks. No item in the source was explicitly marked solved, so all meta.is_solved values are false.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/2012.02524.json and outputs/latest.json.
